title: We Will Punish the Aggressor Today
text:
We Will Punish the Aggressor Today"

"Complete Destruction of Three F-35 Aircraft and Heavy Damage to Three Others at Al-Azraq in Response to the American Enemy's Crime in Qeshm"

"Public Relations Department of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC)"
"In the Name of God, the Breaker of Tyrants"

""Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, God is Most Powerful to give them victory.""
"(Quran, 22:39)"

"🔹 To the noble and discerning people of Jordan—your sincere solidarity and cooperation, particularly the clear stances taken by various groups among Jordan's elite, have narrowed the field for the enemy and left them utterly desperate."

"🔹 At dawn today, the American enemy—incapable of honorable military confrontation—cowardly used their occupying bases in your country to launch an airstrike against two residential homes on Qeshm Island, employing bunker-buster bombs. They targeted the simple homes of local residents, resulting in the martyrdom of a father, mother, and one child, and the wounding of two other children."

"🔹 In response to this crime, and to assist you in liberating the Islamic land of Jordan from the scourge of American occupiers, the warriors of the IRGC Aerospace Force struck the deployment ramp and maintenance hangar of the American enemy's F-35 fighters at Al-Azraq Air Base this morning, using several ballistic missiles. Three F-35 aircraft were completely destroyed, and three others sustained heavy damage."

"🔹 Several enemy officers and technical/maintenance personnel were also killed in this strike."

"🔹 Our region is no place for a child-killing army that so ruthlessly murders innocent families in the dead of night, while they sleep. Our struggle and yours will continue until the expulsion of the last American occupier from the Islamic lands."

""If you support God, He will support you and make your feet firm.
